title: Apply backspace markers after consuming escaped characters
goal: Repair erase_marked(text, marker='#', escape='\'), with string inputs. marker and escape must each have exactly one character and be distinct; otherwise raise ValueError even for empty text. Process left to right: an unescaped marker deletes the last character already present in output if any, and otherwise does nothing. An escape consumes and quotes the next character literally, including a marker or another escape, removing only the escape itself. An unmatched trailing escape is kept literally. A later unescaped marker may delete any previously emitted character, including a quoted marker or escape. Return the resulting string, do not mutate inputs, and preserve the signature.
constraints: Do not add files, dependencies, or modify tests.
Keep erase_marked and its signature unchanged.

provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct inputs exercising the same stated specification
